correctness.rationale: For fixed q≥2 and uniform isomorphism classes of q-named-colour partial injections, every weakly connected component is an oriented colour-word chain or an oriented colour-necklace cycle, with q^ℓ and c_q(ℓ) types respectively. Product ∏(1−z^ℓ)^{−(q^ℓ+c_q(ℓ))} factors as H_q(z)(1−qz)⁻¹ exp(qz/(1−qz)), H analytic inside |z|<q^(−1/2). Laguerre saddle transfer yields a_{q,n}~constant·q^n n^(−1/4)e^{2√n}, fixed-h coefficient ratio q^(−h)(1−h/√n+O(n⁻¹)). Polynomial markings show joint finite-component counts converge independently to Geom(1−q^(−ℓ)) and yield the sharp coloured-singleton event probability 1/q−1/(q√n)+O(n⁻¹). Bounded-degree Hanf locality reduces FO sentences to truncated short components plus long-chain neighbourhood cylinders; forbidden cylinder generating functions have smaller essential-singularity constant, giving stretched-exponential saturation for each generic neighbourhood. This proves rational FO limits with O(n^−1/2), and for q=1 partition-ratio→1 forces each fixed component arbitrarily often, proving a zero-one law. Independent distinct Euler-product computation for q2 n=0..8 produced 1,4,17,60,203,640,1959,5776,16650. Inspected actual checker.py; finite checks do not establish saddle/Hanf steps.
